entry.en: Your passport must be valid at least 6 months after arrival and have at least 2 blank pages for entry stamps.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe ser válido al menos 6 meses después de la llegada y tener al menos 2 páginas en blanco para sellos de entrada.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and at least 2 blank pages for entry stamps.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país catalogado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove that you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination, if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.
entry.es: Debes declarar todo lo que pueda estar prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles.
entry.quote: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

entry.en: Everyone needs a passport, an onward ticket and sufficient funds to cover their stay.
entry.es: Todos necesitan pasaporte, billete de salida y fondos suficientes para cubrir su estancia.
entry.quote: Everyone needs a passport, onward ticket, and sufficient funds to cover their stay in the Solomon Islands.

entry.en: Keep printed copies or screenshots of your visa documents, including the Visa Application Reference Number, as you may be asked to show them.
entry.es: Lleva copias impresas o capturas de tus documentos de visa, incluido el número de referencia de la solicitud, pues pueden pedírtelos.
entry.quote: Keep printed copies or screenshots of your visa documents with you when you travel, including the Visa Application Reference Number (VARN).

safety.en: Police have limited resources and often respond slowly to calls for help.
safety.es: La policía tiene recursos limitados y a menudo responde despacio a las llamadas de ayuda.
safety.quote: The Royal Solomon Islands Police Force has limited resources and police often respond slowly to calls for help.

safety.en: Robberies involving violence, bag snatching and pickpocketing happen, particularly around the central market and local beaches.
safety.es: Ocurren robos con violencia, tirones de bolso y carterismo, sobre todo en torno al mercado central y las playas locales.
safety.quote: Robberies involving violence, handbag snatching, pickpocketing, distraction thefts and harassment happen, particularly around the central market and local beaches.

safety.en: Demonstrations in Honiara can turn violent quickly and lead to civil unrest.
safety.es: Las manifestaciones en Honiara pueden volverse violentas rápidamente y derivar en disturbios civiles.
safety.quote: They can turn violent quickly and lead to civil unrest. Avoid protests and political gatherings and be cautious.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual activity is illegal, and penalties can include a prison sentence.
safety.es: La actividad sexual entre personas del mismo sexo es ilegal y las penas pueden incluir prisión.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual activity is illegal, and penalties can include a prison sentence.

safety.en: Earthquakes and tremors are a constant risk because the islands lie in the Pacific Ring of Fire.
safety.es: Los terremotos y temblores son un riesgo constante porque las islas están en el Cinturón de Fuego del Pacífico.
safety.quote: The Solomon Islands are in the ‘Pacific Ring of Fire’, an active zone where earthquakes and tremors are a constant risk.

safety.en: There are unexploded weapons throughout the Solomon Islands, so get local advice before visiting certain areas.
safety.es: Hay armas sin explotar por todas las Islas Salomón, así que pide consejo local antes de visitar ciertas zonas.
safety.quote: There are unexploded weapons throughout the Solomon Islands. The condition and stability of the weapons is unknown.

health.en: Healthcare facilities are very basic, with limited hospital facilities and medical supplies that are not always available.
health.es: Los servicios sanitarios son muy básicos, con instalaciones hospitalarias limitadas y suministros médicos no siempre disponibles.
health.quote: Healthcare facilities in the Solomon Islands are very basic. There are limited hospital facilities and medical supplies are not always available.

health.en: Health risks include Zika virus, malaria and dengue.
health.es: Entre los riesgos para la salud figuran el zika, la malaria y el dengue.
health.quote:
See what health risks you’ll face in the Solomon Islands, including:

- Zika virus

- malaria

- dengue

health.en: Malaria is described as the biggest health issue, and travellers are advised to take anti-malarial pills before, during and after their stay.
health.es: Se describe la malaria como el mayor problema de salud y se aconseja tomar pastillas antipalúdicas antes, durante y después de la estancia.
health.quote: Malaria is the biggest health issue in the Solomon Islands.  Travellers to the area should take anti-malarial pills before, during and after their stay.

health.en: Visitors are advised not to drink tap water straight and to boil it first or drink bottled water.
health.es: Se aconseja no beber agua del grifo directamente, sino hervirla antes o beber agua embotellada.
health.quote: Visitors are advised not to drink the water straight from the tap. Boil it first or drink bottled water.

health.en: Make sure you have accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment and repatriation.
health.es: Asegúrate de tener fondos accesibles para cubrir el costo de cualquier tratamiento médico y repatriación.
health.quote: Make sure you have accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment and repatriation.

help.en: Emergency numbers are ambulance 111, fire 988 and police 999.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son ambulancia 111, bomberos 988 y policía 999.

getting_in.en: Honiara International Airport is 11 km east of the capital, and scheduled flights depart from Brisbane most days.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional de Honiara está a 11 km al este de la capital y hay vuelos regulares desde Brisbane casi todos los días.
getting_in.quote: Honiara International Airport HIR IATA is 11 km (7 miles) east of the capital, Honiara. Scheduled flights depart from Brisbane, Australia most days.

getting_in.en: Munda Airport is in the Western Province, next to the town of Munda.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Munda está en la Provincia Occidental, junto a la ciudad de Munda.
getting_in.quote: Munda Airport MUA  IATA in the Western Province, next to the town of Munda.

getting_in.en: Locals routinely travel by boat between southern Bougainville in Papua New Guinea and the Shortland Islands.
getting_in.es: Los lugareños viajan habitualmente en barco entre el sur de Bougainville, en Papúa Nueva Guinea, y las islas Shortland.
getting_in.quote: travel from southern Bougainville in Papua New Guinea by boat into the Solomon Islands western province, as locals routinely travel between the Solomons' Shortland Islands and Bougainville.

getting_around.en: A ferry runs most days from Honiara Wharf to Auki on Malaita.
getting_around.es: Un ferry sale casi todos los días del muelle de Honiara a Auki, en Malaita.
getting_around.quote: This runs most days from Honiara Wharf to Auki on the island of Malaita across the Slot from Honiara.

getting_around.en: The Auki ferry boards at 07:30 for an 08:00 departure.
getting_around.es: El ferry a Auki embarca a las 07:30 para una salida a las 08:00.
getting_around.quote: Boarding is at 07:30 for an 08:00 departure. Buy your ticket from a vehicle parked outside the jetty gate in the wharf car park.

getting_around.en: Solomon Airlines offers numerous flights around the islands.
getting_around.es: Solomon Airlines ofrece numerosos vuelos entre las islas.
getting_around.quote: Solomon Airlines offers numerous flights around the islands.

getting_around.en: Bring your own lifejacket when travelling by ferry between islands.
getting_around.es: Lleva tu propio chaleco salvavidas al viajar en ferry entre islas.
getting_around.quote: Bring your own lifejacket when travelling by ferry between islands.

getting_around.en: There are few roads, mostly on Guadalcanal and Malaita, and many are heavily pot-holed.
getting_around.es: Hay pocas carreteras, sobre todo en Guadalcanal y Malaita, y muchas están llenas de baches.
getting_around.quote: There are few roads in the Solomon Islands. Most of these are on Guadalcanal and Malaita. Many roads are heavily pot-holed

money.en: The currency is the Solomon Islands dollar (SBD), divided into 100 cents.
money.es: La moneda es el dólar de las Islas Salomón (SBD), dividido en 100 centavos.
money.quote: The currency of the country is the Solomon Islands dollar, denoted by the symbol "SI$" (ISO currency code: SBD). The currency is divided into 100 cents.

money.en: ATMs are only available in Honiara, Gizo, Munda and Auki.
money.es: Solo hay cajeros automáticos en Honiara, Gizo, Munda y Auki.
money.quote: ATMs are only available in Honiara, Gizo, Munda and Auki.

money.en: Only major hotels and restaurants in Honiara accept international credit cards.
money.es: Solo los grandes hoteles y restaurantes de Honiara aceptan tarjetas de crédito internacionales.
money.quote: Only major hotels and restaurants in Honiara accept international credit cards.

money.en: Australian dollars are accepted at some hotels and resorts.
money.es: Algunos hoteles y complejos turísticos aceptan dólares australianos.
money.quote: Australian dollars are accepted at some hotels and resorts
Allow SI$35 for a meal in the basic restaurant. Tips are not customary.

etiquette.en: Swearing is illegal and could bring a large compensation claim or even a prison sentence.
etiquette.es: Decir palabrotas es ilegal y puede acarrear una gran reclamación de indemnización o incluso prisión.
etiquette.quote: Swearing is illegal. If you swear at someone, you could face a large compensation claim, or even a prison sentence.

etiquette.en: Dress conservatively with shoulders and knees covered, especially for women, and avoid beach clothes away from the beach.
etiquette.es: Viste de forma conservadora, con hombros y rodillas cubiertos, sobre todo las mujeres, y evita la ropa de playa lejos de la playa.
etiquette.quote: Dress conservatively, with shoulders and knees covered, especially if you’re a woman. Wearing beach clothes away from the beach may cause offence.

etiquette.en: Ask permission before entering a village, going ashore on a locally owned island, or visiting a beach, reef or cultural site.
etiquette.es: Pide permiso antes de entrar en una aldea, desembarcar en una isla de propiedad local o visitar una playa, arrecife o sitio cultural.
etiquette.quote: Ask permission before entering a village, going ashore on a locally owned island, following a trail or visiting a beach, reef, shrine or cultural site.

etiquette.en: Always ask before photographing people, homes, ceremonies, graves, sacred places or cultural objects.
etiquette.es: Pregunta siempre antes de fotografiar personas, casas, ceremonias, tumbas, lugares sagrados u objetos culturales.
etiquette.quote: Always ask before photographing people, homes, ceremonies, graves, sacred places or cultural objects.

etiquette.en: Some ‘tabu’ sites have restricted use and access, for example where only men are allowed.
etiquette.es: Algunos sitios ‘tabu’ tienen uso y acceso restringidos, por ejemplo donde solo se permite la entrada a hombres.
etiquette.quote: In certain areas there are ‘tabu’ sites with restricted use and access, for example where only men are allowed.

etiquette.en: On some trails and beaches you may need to pay a fee (‘kastom’) to the landowner.
etiquette.es: En algunos senderos y playas puede que debas pagar una tarifa (‘kastom’) al propietario de la tierra.
etiquette.quote: On some hiking trails or on many of the beaches around Honiara, you may need to pay a fee (‘kastom’) to the landowner.

connectivity.en: There are two cellular providers, Our Telekom and Bmobile.
connectivity.es: Hay dos operadores móviles, Our Telekom y Bmobile.
connectivity.quote: There are 2 cellular providers on the island Our Telekom and Bmobile.

connectivity.en: Internet is routed through satellite, making connections slow, with Wi-Fi at some hotels and restaurants.
connectivity.es: Todo el internet pasa por satélite, lo que hace lentas las conexiones, y hay wifi en algunos hoteles y restaurantes.
connectivity.quote: all internet is routed through satellite making connections slow. There is Wi-Fi at some hotels and restaurants.
